title: WellaPath Nigeria facilities — served projection, schema 2.0, GRID3 lineage (candidate)
description:
The compact distribution shape of the GRID3-lineage candidate, projected from the internal audit/master candidate (candidate/facilities.ng.v2.0-grid3.json) with zero value changes. Every design fact below is VERIFIED against the Mobile PR #79 parser at wellapath-mobile 854377c0 (lib/core/facilities_v2/facilities_v2_parser.dart), not assumed:

 * The parser requires top-level schema_version (a string starting '2.') and a non-empty facilities list; _metadata is ignored by the parser and exists for governance.
 * A record is consumed through the keys {id, name, latitude, longitude, type, emergency_capable, state, lga, city_area, phone, opening_hours}; id, name and finite in-range coordinates are required or the record is rejected; every OPTIONAL key is read with raw[...] so an ABSENT key parses identically to an explicit null (type -> unspecified, emergency_capable -> unknown, phone/opening_hours -> null). type and emergency_capable therefore REMAIN NULL to the consumer while being absent from the bytes, and this schema forbids the keys outright (additionalProperties false), so populating either before its decision (FAC-D001 / FAC-D002) is schema-invalid, not merely discouraged.
 * Keys the parser does not consume are retained per record as an opaque provenance map in device memory — so the projection carries none: no source_record, no country (constant 'ng', stated once in _metadata), no lga (the master's lga always equals city_area, and search matches lga/city_area by equality but only city_area and name by containment, so city_area alone preserves the full search surface — verified in facilities_v2_search.dart).
 * Traceability needs no extra field: id IS the source reference — 'ng_g3_' + the GRID3 globalid (uuid: prefix stripped, lowercased), joining 1:1 to the master record and to the licensed GRID3 source row.

The artifact is serialized as compact canonical JSON (no whitespace, ensure_ascii, no trailing newline); the manifest sha256 is over exactly those raw bytes (the Mobile loader hash-verifies raw bytes; gzip is a measurement, not the delivery contract).

schema_version.description: Top level, because the verified parser reads artifact['schema_version'] there. The _metadata copy is for humans and governance tooling.

role.description: Pinned. Distinguishes this artifact from the internal audit/master candidate (role implied master) and from the raw source CSV. The three are named apart in every manifest and document.

master_candidate.description: The internal audit/master candidate this projection was computed from, bound by hash. Full provenance, source_record traceability and the isolation proof live there and in its reports; they are not repeated per served record.

attribution_citation.const: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University 2024. GRID3 NGA - Health Facilities v2.0. New York: GRID3. https://doi.org/10.7916/kv1n-0743. Accessed 20 July 2026.

source.description: Licence, citation and modification disclosure stated ONCE here rather than on every record, as the licence requires them to travel with the artifact.

id.description: The stable facility_id, under the key the verified parser consumes. Doubles as the record-level source reference: ng_g3_ + GRID3 globalid, joining 1:1 to the master record and the licensed source row.

served_facility.description: type, emergency_capable, phone, opening_hours, lga, country and source_record are deliberately ABSENT: the verified parser reads an absent optional key as null (type unspecified, emergency unknown, phone/hours null), unconsumed keys would sit in device memory as opaque provenance, and additionalProperties:false makes premature population schema-invalid rather than a convention.
